description: This file defines a mock data class for providing sample news articles used as fallback data in a Flutter news app. It creates static article objects with predefined content for offline or fallback scenarios.

classes.name: MockNewsData
classes.description: A utility class providing static mock news articles for different categories, used when network data is unavailable.

methods.name: forCategory
methods.description: Returns a list of mock NewsArticle objects tailored for a specific category, combining common base articles with category-specific extras.
